title: Caption Observatory · CPU Image Captioning
description:
DA3408 · Health → workload → latency → hardware. Real 5-second scrapes. AI-generated PromQL: attribution prompt and worked calculations are in README.md.
AI prompt: Build a professional DA3408 dashboard using caption_* metrics and node_exporter; include health, mode throughput, errors, mean and histogram quantiles, bulk size, CPU/RAM/disk and bulk correlation. Explain every query, use bounded labels, accessible colors, explicit units, linear axes, and 5s refresh. Include overlay filesystems for a container-based cloud machine while excluding pseudo filesystems.

panels.title: Application availability
panels.description: 1 = metrics endpoint reachable; 0 = scrape failed. This checks scrape health; model readiness is separate.

panels.title: Pretrained model ready
panels.description: 1 = CPU model loaded successfully. 0 is expected before first successful load.

panels.title: Images attempted
panels.description: Cumulative per-image attempts, including decode or inference failures. Invalid whole archives are request errors instead.

panels.title: Image outcomes
panels.description: Cumulative successes and failures, summed over modes and bounded client categories.

panels.title: Single versus bulk throughput
panels.description: Images per second over a rolling 1-minute window. Includes all per-image outcomes.

panels.title: Image success and failure counts
panels.description: Cumulative counts: steps represent actual processed images; restarts reset counters.

panels.title: Overall image processing rate
panels.description: Rolling 1-minute rate across modes and results; zero during a stable idle period.

panels.title: Mean inference latency
panels.description: Generation seconds divided by completed inference count over 2 minutes. Zero when there are no observations in the window.

panels.title: Inference latency distribution
panels.description: P50/P95/P99 estimated from classic histogram buckets over 5 minutes. Quantiles are absent until inference observations exist.

panels.title: Active uploads and CPU inferences
panels.description: Concurrent uploads include validation and model loading. Model generation is serialized to limit memory.

panels.title: Bulk workload and batch size
panels.description: Active bulk is transient. Last batch size persists after completion so idle periods remain interpretable.

panels.title: Upload duration
panels.description: Mean whole request seconds over 5 minutes, including decode and model cold start.

panels.title: Host CPU utilization
panels.description: 100 × (1 − average idle CPU rate). Scope is the available cloud host, which can include other activity.

panels.title: Host RAM utilization
panels.description: 100 × (1 − available RAM / total RAM). Available includes reclaimable cache.

panels.title: Caption process RSS
panels.description: Resident process bytes sampled every second; includes Python, tensors and loaded weights.

panels.title: Disk utilization
panels.description: Percentage used on writable real filesystems. In containers the root overlay may represent the cloud machine filesystem.

panels.title: Bulk correlation · CPU and activity
panels.description: Shared time axis: compare CPU percent against the right-axis bulk-active signal. Correlation does not establish causation.

panels.title: Bulk correlation · memory and activity
panels.description: Process RSS with the bulk-active signal on a separate right axis. Model loading also changes memory.

panels.title: Errors by operation
panels.description: Cumulative errors distinguish archive validation, image decode, model loading, and inference.

panels.title: Batch size distribution
panels.description: Histogram-derived mean number of candidate images in bulk uploads over 5 minutes.
